fact: As at May 2025 Angola's market comprised telco and carrier-neutral providers: MSTelcom managed three data centre facilities, Unitel two smaller ones and Angola Cables a roughly 400-rack facility (AngoNAP), and INFOSI had announced an $89m project for two government-owned data centres of about 200 racks.
title: Southern Africa Data Center Markets: a Xalam market brief
publisher: Xalam Analytics for Digital Investment Facility, HAUS and GIZ
